description: No defined processes for restricting access based on business need to know.
applicability: This signal applies to: Organizations processing, storing, or transmitting cardholder data Identity and access management systems User directories and authentication services Administrative access to CDE components Remote access to payment systems

related_controls: 7.1 Processes and mechanisms for restricting access to system components and cardholder data by business need to know are defined and understood.
metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Review organizational policies and procedures for evidence of documented access restriction processes. Look for formal access request and approval workflows, documented business justification requirements, and periodic access reviews. Absence of these documented processes indicates this signal.
